description:
Measurement infrastructure for the plan-cache round (2026-11-13): a
second debug-only logcat line, tag "ritim-stab-timing", one per
rendered frame at EVERY tier:

  ritim-stab-timing: frame=N planMs=..(cache-hit|computed) warpMs=.. totalMs=..

planMs is the stabilizationFrameFor span (cache lookup or full plan
compute — the (cache-hit|computed) marker is the fromCache out-flag
commit 062ffa0 plumbed), warpMs the warpFrame span, totalMs the two
combined. A refusing frame (Off / NoImu / Unsynced) emits the same
shape with warpMs=0.000 — one uniform format per rendered frame, so a
skip reads as "the plan ran, the warp did not".

Unlike the existing "ritim-stab" line (settle-class renders only:
paused >= 1280 and full res), this fires per render including
playback, because the owner's ON/OFF playback comparison happens
DURING playback — that is the measurement this line exists for. The
